annotations.text:
Two directions for the same workspace — pick one and I'll build it.

A · CONSOLE — dark, dense, instrument-like. Everything visible at once, monospace throughout, nothing hidden behind a menu. Trades approachability for control.

B · MANUSCRIPT — light, editorial. The prompt is typeset as a document and the check findings sit in the margin as editorial notes. Trades density for calm; a first-time visitor understands it faster.
Supporting panels, drawn in direction A. 'Connect a model' is the honest answer to the GitHub Pages question — it diagnoses the exact failure rather than just saying it didn't work.
